Given:

\n\n

The spherical balls of radius 6 cm can be made by melting a hemisphere of radius 24 cm

\n\n

The radius of the sphere is  r

\n\n

The volume of a hemisphere = 2 / 3 πr3.

\n\n

Concept used:

\n\n

Their volume will be the same.

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Let the number is N

\n\n

As per the question,

\n\n

\n\n

= 32

24 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले एक अर्धगोले को पिघलाकर 6 सेमी त्रिज्या वाली गोलाकार गेंदें बनाई जा सकती हैं।

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

गोले का आयतन = 4/3 πr3 

\n\n

गोले की त्रिज्या r है।

\n\n

अर्धगोले का आयतन = 2/3 πr3 

\n\n

प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

\n\n

इनका आयतन समान होगा।

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

⇒ 4/3 π(6)3 = 2/3 N π(24)3

\n\n

⇒ N = \\(24\\times 24\\times 24\\over 2\\times 6\\times 6\\times 6\\) 

\n\n

= 32

\n\n

Relationship between Volume and Surface Area of Sphere

The Volume (V) of a sphere can be expressed in terms of its Surface Area (S) as V = (S × r) ÷ 3.

Given:

\n\n

Surface area of the sphere = 616 cm2

\n\n

\\(\\pi = \\frac{22}{7}\\)

\n\n

Formula Used:

\n\n

Surface area of a sphere = \\(4\\pi r^2\\)

\n\n

Diameter of the sphere = \\(2r\\)

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Surface area = \\(4\\pi r^2\\)

\n\n

⇒ 616 = \\(4 \\times \\frac{22}{7} \\times r^2\\)

\n\n

⇒ 616 = \\(\\frac{88}{7} \\times r^2\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(r^2 = \\frac{616 \\times 7}{88}\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(r^2 = \\frac{4312}{88}\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(r^2 = 49\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(r = \\sqrt{49}\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(r = 7\\)

\n\n

Diameter = \\(2r\\)

\n\n

⇒ Diameter = 2 × 7

\n\n

⇒ Diameter = 14 cm

\n\n

Therefore, the diameter of the sphere is 14 cm.

ગોળાની સપાટીનો વિસ્તાર = \\(4\\pi r^2\\)

\n\n

ગોળાનો વ્યાસ = \\(2r\\)

\n\n

ગણતરી:

\n\n

સપાટી વિસ્તાર = \\(4\\pi r^2\\)

\n\n

⇒ 616 = \\(4 \\times \\frac{22}{7} \\times r^2\\)

\n\n

⇒ 616 = \\(\\frac{88}{7} \\times r^2\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(r^2 = \\frac{616 \\times 7}{88}\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(r^2 = \\frac{4312}{88}\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(r^2 = 49\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(r = \\sqrt{49}\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(r = 7\\)

\n\n

વ્યાસ = \\(2r\\)

\n\n

⇒ વ્યાસ = 2 x 7

\n\n

⇒ વ્યાસ = 14 સે.મી

\n\n

તેથી, ગોળાનો વ્યાસ 14 સે.મી.

Given data:

\n\n

Curved surface area of a sphere with radius R1 is the same as the total surface area of another hemisphere with radius R2.

Concept:

\n\n

दी गई जानकारी:

\n\n

त्रिज्या R1 वाले एक गोले का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल, त्रिज्या R2 वाले दूसरे अर्धगोले के कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल के बराबर है।

\n\n

अवधारणा:

\n\n

एक गोले का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 4πR12, और

\n\n

अर्धगोले का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 3πR22.

\n\n

यदि वे समान हैं, तो 4πR12 = 3πR22.

\n\n

हल:

\n\n

⇒  R2 = √((4/3)R12) = (2/√(3))R1

\n\n

अतः, R2, (2/√(3))R1 है।

Given data:

\n\n

R1 వ్యాసార్థం ఉన్న గోళం యొక్క వక్ర ఉపరితల వైశాల్యం R2 వ్యాసార్థంతో మరొక అర్ధగోళం యొక్క మొత్తం ఉపరితల వైశాల్యం వలె ఉంటుంది.

\n\n

Concept:

\n\n

గోళం యొక్క వక్ర ఉపరితల వైశాల్యం = 4πR1Given data:

\n\n

R1 వ్యాసార్థం ఉన్న గోళం యొక్క వక్ర ఉపరితల వైశాల్యం R2 వ్యాసార్థంతో మరొక అర్ధగోళం యొక్క మొత్తం ఉపరితల వైశాల్యం వలె ఉంటుంది.

\n\n

Concept:

\n\n

గోళం యొక్క వక్ర ఉపరితల వైశాల్యం = 4πR12, మరియు

\n\n

అర్ధగోళం యొక్క మొత్తం ఉపరితల వైశాల్యం = 3πR22.

\n\n

అవి సమానంగా ఉంటే, అప్పుడు दिलेली माहिती:

\n\n

त्रिज्या R1 एकक असलेल्या गोलाचे वक्र पृष्ठभाग क्षेत्रफळ R2 त्रिज्या असलेल्या दुसर्‍या गोलार्धाच्या एकूण पृष्ठभागाच्या क्षेत्रफळाइतकेच आहे

\n\n

संकल्पना:

\n\n

गोलाचे वक्र पृष्ठभाग क्षेत्रफळ = 4πR12, आणि

\n\n

गोलार्धाच्या एकूण पृष्ठभागाच्या क्षेत्रफळ = 3πR22.

\n\n

जर ते समान असतील, तर 4πR12 = 3πR22.

\n\n

उपाय:

\n\n

⇒ R2 = √((4/3)R12) = (2/√(3))R1

\n\n

म्हणून, R2 हे (2/√(3))R1 आहे.

ধারণা:

একটি গোলকের বক্রতলের ক্ষেত্রফল = 4πR12, এবং

\n\n

একটি অর্ধগোলকের মোট পৃষ্ঠতলের ক্ষেত্রফল = 3πR22.

\n\n

যদি তারা সমান হয়, তাহলে 4πR12 = 3πR22.

\n\n

সমাধান:

\n\n

\n\n

অতএব, R2 হল (2/√(3))R1

ત્રિજ્યા R1 વાળા ગોળાકારનો વક્ર સપાટી વિસ્તાર એ ત્રિજ્યા R2 સાથે અન્ય ગોળાર્ધના કુલ સપાટી વિસ્તાર જેટલો છે.

\n\n

Given Data:

\n\n

A solid sphere is cut into two equal halves.

\n\n

Concept:

\n\n

The total surface area of a sphere is 4πr2, and

\n\n

The total surface area of a hemisphere is 3πr2.

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

The ratio of the total surface area of each hemisphere to that of the solid sphere = Surface area of hemisphere/Surface area of sphere = 3πr2/4πr2 = 3/4.

\n\n

Therefore, the ratio of the total surface area of each hemisphere to that of the solid sphere is 3 ∶ 4.

दी गई जानकारी:

\n\n

एक ठोस गोले को दो बराबर भागों में काटा जाता है।

\n\n

अतः प्रत्येक अर्धगोले के कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल और ठोस गोले के कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल का अनुपात 3 ∶ 4 है।

கணக்கீடு:

\n\n

ஒவ்வொரு அரைக்கோளத்தின் மொத்த பரப்பளவிற்கும் திடமான கோளத்திற்கும் உள்ள விகிதம் = அரைக்கோளத்தின் ఇచ్చిన దత్తాంశం:

ఒక ఘన గోళం రెండు సమాన భాగాలుగా కత్తిరించబడుతుంది.

\n\n

గోళం యొక్క మొత్తం ఉపరితల వైశాల్యం 4πr2, మరియు

అర్ధగోళం యొక్క మొత్తం ఉపరితల వైశాల్యం 3πr2.

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × π × r3

Volume of cube = a3

Volume of 1 spherical metallic ball,

\n\n

(4/3) × π r3 = (4/3) × (22/7) × 13 = 4.19047 cm3 

\n\n

Volume of 2541spherical metallic balls = 2541 × 4.19047 = 10648 cm3

Volume of 2541 spherical metallic balls = Volume of cube

\n\n

⇒ a3 = 10648

\n\n

∴ a = 22

\n\n

Now,

\n\n

Surface area of cube = 6a2

\n\n

⇒ 6 × 222 = 2904 cm2

"2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

Relation between Volume (V) and Curved Surface Area (S) of a sphere: V = (r ÷ 3) × S

\n

First, find radius r: r2 = S ÷ 4π ⇒ r2 = 1386 ÷ (4 × 22/7) = 110.25

\n

⇒ r = √110.25 = 10.5 cm

\n

Now, Volume V = (10.5 ÷ 3) × 1386 = 3.5 × 1386

\n

V = 4851 cm3

\n

∴ The correct answer is 4851 cm3.

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of sphere = 1386 cm2

\n

Formula Used:

\n

1. Surface Area of Sphere = 4πr2

\n

2. Volume of Sphere = (4/3)πr3

\n
\n

Calculations:

\n

⇒ 4 × (22/7) × r2 = 1386

\n

⇒ r2 = (1386 × 7) ÷ (4 × 22)

\n

⇒ r2 = (63 × 7) ÷ 4 = 441 ÷ 4

\n

⇒ r = √(441 ÷ 4) = 21 ÷ 2 = 10.5 cm

\n

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × (21/2) × (21/2) × (21/2)

\n

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × (9261/8)

\n

⇒ Volume = 11 × 21 × 21 = 4851 cm3

\n

∴ The correct answer is 4851 cm3.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n

Surface Area of Hemisphere

\n

Curved Surface Area = 2πr2 and Total Surface Area = 3πr2.

\n

Volume of Hemisphere

\n

The volume is exactly half of a sphere: V = (2/3)πr3.

\n

Relationship between Radius and Area

\n

If the radius is doubled, the Surface Area becomes 4 times (22) and the Volume becomes 8 times (23). Shortcut Trick\n

एक गोले के आयतन (V) और वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (S) के बीच संबंध: V = (r ÷ 3) × S

\n

सबसे पहले, त्रिज्या r ज्ञात करें: r2 = S ÷ 4π ⇒ r2 = 1386 ÷ (4 × 22/7) = 110.25

\n

⇒ r = √110.25 = 10.5 सेमी

\n

अब, आयतन V = (10.5 ÷ 3) × 1386 = 3.5 × 1386

\n

V = 4851 सेमी3

\n

∴ सही उत्तर 4851 सेमी3 है।

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n

\n

\n

\n

\n

2. गोले का आयतन = (4/3)πr3

\n
\n

गणना:

\n

⇒ 4 × (22/7) × r2 = 1386

\n

⇒ r2 = (1386 × 7) ÷ (4 × 22)

\n

⇒ r2 = (63 × 7) ÷ 4 = 441 ÷ 4

\n

⇒ r = √(441 ÷ 4) = 21 ÷ 2 = 10.5 सेमी

\n

⇒ आयतन = (4/3) × (22/7) × (21/2) × (21/2) × (21/2)

\n

⇒ आयतन = (4/3) × (22/7) × (9261/8)

\n

⇒ आयतन = 11 × 21 × 21 = 4851 सेमी3

\n

∴ सही उत्तर 4851 सेमी3 है।

\n\n

Additional Information

\n

अर्धगोले का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल

\n

वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 2πr2 और कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 3πr2.

\n

अर्धगोले का आयतन

\n

आयतन गोले का ठीक आधा होता है: V = (2/3)πr3.

\n

त्रिज्या और क्षेत्रफल के बीच संबंध

\n

यदि त्रिज्या दोगुनी हो जाती है, तो पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 4 गुना (22) हो जाता है और आयतन 8 गुना (23) हो जाता है।

दिया गया है:

\n\n

मूल गोले की त्रिज्या (R) = 15 सेमी

\n\n

प्रत्येक छोटी गेंद की त्रिज्या (r) = 3 सेमी

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

गोले का आयतन = \\(\\frac{4}{3}\\pi r^3\\)

\n\n

गोले का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = \\(4\\pi r^2\\)

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

मूल गोले का आयतन = \\(\\frac{4}{3}\\pi (15)^3 = \\frac{4}{3}\\pi × 3375 = 4500\\pi\\)

\n\n

एक छोटी गेंद का आयतन = \\(\\frac{4}{3}\\pi (3)^3 = \\frac{4}{3}\\pi × 27 = 36\\pi\\)

\n\n

छोटी गेंदों की संख्या = \\(\\frac{4500\\pi}{36\\pi} = 125\\)

\n\n

मूल गोले का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = \\(4\\pi (15)^2 = 4\\pi × 225 = 900\\pi\\)

\n\n

1 छोटी गेंद का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = \\(4\\pi (3)^2 = 4\\pi × 9 = 36\\pi\\)

\n\n

125 गेंदों का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = \\(125 × 36\\pi = 4500\\pi\\)

\n\n

अभीष्ट अनुपात = \\(\\frac{900\\pi}{4500\\pi} = \\frac{1}{5}\\)

\n\n

इसलिए अभीष्ट अनुपात = 1 : 5

"value": "r ≥ s"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "r = s"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "r < s"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Given:

\n\n

The total surface area of a sphere of radius r cm is equal to the total surface area of a cube of side s cm

\n\n

Concept used:

\n\n

Total surface area of a sphere = 4πr2

\n\n

Total surface area of a cube = 6a2

\n\n

Here,

\n\n

a = side of the cube

\n\n

r is the radius of the sphere

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

According to the question,

\n\n

4πr2 = 6s2

\n\n

⇒ 44r2 = 21s2

\n\n

⇒ r2/s2 = 21/44

\n\n

So, value of r will be in between 4 and 5

\n\n

Value of s will be between 6 and 7

\n\n

So, from this we can say r < s

\n\n

∴ The required answer is Option 4.

", "hn": "\n

दिया गया है:

\n\n

त्रिज्या r सेमी के एक वृत्त का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल s सेमी भुजा वाले घन के कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल के बराबर है।

\n\n

प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

\n\n

वृत्त का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 4πr2

\n\n

घन का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 6a2

\n\n

यहाँ,

\n\n

a = घन की भुजा

\n\n

r वृत्त की त्रिज्या है।

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

प्रश्न के अनुसार,

\n\n

4πr2 = 6s2

\n\n

⇒ 44r2 = 21s2

\n\n

⇒ r2/s2 = 21/44

\n\n

इसलिए r का मान 4 और 5 के बीच होगा।

\n\n

s का मान 6 और 7 के बीच होगा।

\n\n

अतः, इससे हम कह सकते हैं कि r < s है।

\n\n

∴ अभीष्ट उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

ఇచ్చిన:

\n\n

వ్యాసార్థం r సెం.మీ గల గోళం యొక్క సంపూర్ణతల వైశాల్యం s సెం.మీ భుజం గల ఘనం యొక్క సంపూర్ణతల వైశాల్యానికి సమానంగా ఉంటుంది

\n\n

ఉపయోగించిన భావన:

\n\n

గోళం యొక్క సంపూర్ణతల వైశాల్యం = 4πr2

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n

\n

Formula Used:

\n

Area of Square = s2

\n

\n

⇒ (4/3) π R3 = 500π/3

\n

⇒ 4 × R3 = 500

\n

⇒ R3 = 125

\n

\n

⇒ Side of Square (s) = 40/100 × 5

\n

⇒ s = 0.4 × 5 = 2 m

\n

⇒ Area of Square = 2 × 2

\n

⇒ Area = 4 m2

\n

∴ The correct answer is 4 m2.

Additional Information

\n

Surface Area of Sphere

\n

The total surface area of a sphere is given by the formula A = 4πR2.

\n

Properties of a Square

\n

A square has four equal sides and each interior angle is 90°. Perimeter = 4 × side, and Area = side2.

\n

Volume of Hemisphere

\n

The volume of a hemisphere is exactly half that of a sphere, calculated as V = (2/3) π R3. Shortcut Trick\n

\n

\n

गणना:

\n

\n

⇒ 4 × R3 = 500

\n

⇒ R3 = 125

\n

⇒ R = √3125 = 5 मीटर

\n

⇒ वर्ग की भुजा (s) = 40/100 × 5

\n

⇒ s = 0.4 × 5 = 2 मीटर

\n

⇒ वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल = 2 × 2

\n

⇒ क्षेत्रफल = 4 मीटर2

\n

दिया गया है:

\n\n

21 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले एक ठोस गोले को पिघलाया जाता है और वर्गाकार आधार के एक सम पिरामिड में ढाला जाता है।

\n\n

\n\n

प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

\n\n

1. गोले का आयतन = \\({4\\pi R^3 \\over 3}\\) (R गोले की त्रिज्या है)

\n\n

2. एक वर्गाकार आधार वाले पिरामिड का आयतन = (B = पिरामिड के आधार की प्रत्येक भुजा का माप है और H = ऊँचाई)

\n\n

3. चूँकि गोले को एक सम पिरामिड में ढाला जाता है, इसलिए दोनों ठोस पदार्थों का आयतन समान रहेगा।

गणना:

\n\n

मान लीजिए कि पिरामिड के आधार की प्रत्येक भुजा की माप B है।

\n\n

अवधारणा के अनुसार,

\n\n

\\(\\frac {B^2 × 66}{3}\\) = \\(\\frac {4\\pi × 21^3}{3}\\)

\n\n

⇒ B2 × 66 = 4 × 22/7 × 213

\n\n

⇒ B2 = (4 × 22/7 × 213)/66

\n\n

⇒ B2 = 1764

\n\n

⇒ B = 42

\n\n

∴ पिरामिड के आधार की प्रत्येक भुजा की लम्बाई 42 सेमी है।

\n\n

⇒ B2 = (4 × 22/7 × 213)/66

3. கோளம் ஒழுங்கு நாற்கூம்பாக மாற்றியமைக்கப்படுவதால், இரண்டு திடப்பொருட்களின் கனஅளவும் ஒரே மாதிரியாக இருக்கும்.

\n\n

கணக்கீடு:

\n\n

நாற்கூம்பின் அடிப்பகுதியின் ஒவ்வொரு பக்கத்தின் அளவும் B ஆக இருக்கட்டும்.

\n\n

கருத்தின்படி,

\n\n

\\(\\frac {B^2 × 66}{3}\\) = \\(\\frac {4\\pi × 21^3}{3}\\)

\n\n

⇒ B2 × 66 = 4 × 22/7 × 213

\n\n

⇒ B2 = (4 × 22/7 × 213)/66

\n\n

⇒ B2 = 1764

\n\n

⇒ B = 42

\n\n

∴ நாற்கூம்பின் அடிப்பகுதியின் ஒவ்வொரு பக்கத்தின் நீளமும் 42 செ.மீ. ஆகும்.

\n\n81:Tffe,\n Shortcut Trick\n

Ratio of volumes is equal to the number of identical spheres formed ⇒ Vlarge ÷ Vsmall = 125.

\n

Ratio of radii (R : r) = (125)1/3 : (1)1/3 = 5 : 1.

\n

Given Diameter = 15 cm ⇒ Radius (R) = 7.5 cm.

\n

Radius of small sphere (r) = 7.5 ÷ 5 = 1.5 cm.

\n

Surface Area of small sphere = 4 × π × r2 = 4 × π × (1.5)2 = 9π cm2.

\n

∴ The correct answer is 9 π cm2.

दिया गया है:

\n\n

अर्धगोले की त्रिज्या (r) = 9 सेमी

\n\n

शंकु की ऊँचाई (h) = 72 सेमी

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

अर्धगोले का आयतन = \\(\\frac{2}{3} \\pi r^3\\)

\n\n

शंकु का आयतन = \\(\\frac{1}{3} \\pi R^2 h\\)

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

अर्धगोले का आयतन = \\(\\frac{2}{3} \\pi (9)^3\\)

\n\n

अर्धगोले का आयतन = \\(\\frac{2}{3} \\pi × 729\\)

\n\n

ఇచ్చినవి:

\n\n

అర్ధగోళం యొక్క వ్యాసార్థం (r) = 9 సెం.మీ

\n\n

శంకువు యొక్క ఎత్తు (h) = 72 సెం.మీ

\n\n

ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

\n\n

అర్ధగోళం యొక్క ఘనపరిమాణం = \\(\\frac{2}{3} \\pi r^3\\)

\n\n

శంకువు యొక్క ఘనపరిమాణం = \\(\\frac{1}{3} \\pi R^2 h\\)

\n\n

గణన:

\n\n

అర్ధగోళం యొక్క ఘనపరిమాణం = \\(\\frac{2}{3} \\pi (9)^3\\)

\n\n

అర్ధగోళం యొక్క ఘనపరిమాణం = \\(\\frac{2}{3} \\pi × 729\\)

\n\n

అర్ధగోళం యొక్క ఘనపరిమాణం = \\(\\frac{1458}{3} \\pi\\)

\n\n

అర్ధగోళం యొక్క ఘనపరిమాణం = 486π

\n\n

శంకువు ఘనపరిమాణం = అర్ధగోళం ఘనపరిమాణం

\n\n

\\(\\frac{1}{3} \\pi R^2 × 72 = 486 \\pi\\)

\n\n

⇒ R^2 × 24 = 486

\n\n

⇒ R^2 = \\(\\frac{486}{24}\\)

\n\n

⇒ R^2 = 20.25

\n\n

⇒ R = \\(\\sqrt{20.25}\\)

\n\n

⇒ R = 4.5 సెం.మీ

\n\n

శంకువు యొక్క భూమి వ్యాసార్థం 4.5 సెం.మీ.

Given:

\n\n

If the volume of a sphere is divided by its surface area, the result is 54 cm.

\n\n

Formula used:

\n\n

Volume of a sphere (V) = \\(\\dfrac{4}{3}\\pi r^3\\)

\n\n

Surface area of a sphere (A) = \\(4\\pi r^2\\)

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

\\(\\dfrac{V}{A}\\) = 54

\n\n

\\(\\dfrac{\\dfrac{4}{3}\\pi r^3}{4\\pi r^2} = 54\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(\\dfrac{\\dfrac{4}{3} r}{4} = 54\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(\\dfrac{r}{3} = 54\\)

\n\n

⇒ r = 162 cm

\n\n

∴ The correct answer is option (2).

"end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Given:

\n\n

Diameter of the sphere = 30 cm

\n\n

Radius of the sphere (r1) = 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm

\n\n

Diameter of the wire = 10 cm

\n\n

Radius of the wire (r2) = 10 ÷ 2 = 5 cm

\n\n

Formula used:

\n\n

Volume of sphere = Volume of wire

\n\n

\\(\\dfrac{4}{3}\\pi r_1^3 = \\pi r_2^2 \\times \\text{length of wire (L)}\\)

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

\\(\\dfrac{4}{3} \\pi (15)^3 = \\pi (5)^2 \\times L\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(\\dfrac{4}{3} \\times 15^3 = 5^2 \\times L\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(\\dfrac{4}{3} \\times 3375 = 25 \\times L\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(\\dfrac{13500}{3} = 25 \\times L\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(4500 = 25 \\times L\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(\\dfrac{4500}{25} = L\\)

\n\n

⇒ L = 180 cm

\n\n

∴ The length of the wire is 180 cm.

", "hn": "\n

दिया गया है:

\n\n

गोले का व्यास = 30 सेमी

\n\n

गोले की त्रिज्या (r1) = 30 ÷ 2 = 15 सेमी

\n\n

तार का व्यास = 10 सेमी

\n\n

तार की त्रिज्या (r2) = 10 ÷ 2 = 5 सेमी

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

गोले का आयतन = तार का आयतन

\n\n

\\(\\dfrac{4}{3}\\pi r_1^3 = \\pi r_2^2 \\times \\text{length of wire (L)}\\)

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

\\(\\dfrac{4}{3} \\pi (15)^3 = \\pi (5)^2 \\times L\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(\\dfrac{4}{3} \\times 15^3 = 5^2 \\times L\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(\\dfrac{4}{3} \\times 3375 = 25 \\times L\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(\\dfrac{13500}{3} = 25 \\times L\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(4500 = 25 \\times L\\)

\n\n

⇒ \\(\\dfrac{4500}{25} = L\\)

\n\n

⇒ L = 180 सेमी

\n\n

∴ तार की लंबाई 180 सेमी है।

\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

\n

Radius of the wire (r) = 4 mm = 4/10 = 0.4 cm

\n

Formula Used:

\n

Volume of Cylinder = π × r2 × L

\n

Volume of Sphere = 4/3 × π × R3

\n

Surface Area of Sphere = 4 × π × R2

\n
\n

Calculations:

\n

⇒ Volume of the wire = π × (0.4)2 × 14400

\n

⇒ Volume of the wire = π × 0.16 × 14400 = 2304π cm3

\n

Since the wire is melted to form a sphere, their volumes are equal:

\n

⇒ 4/3 × π × R3 = 2304π

\n

⇒ 4/3 × R3 = 2304

\n

⇒ R3 = (2304 × 3) ÷ 4

\n

⇒ R3 = 576 × 3 = 1728

\n

⇒ R = √31728 = 12 cm

\n

Now, calculating the surface area of the sphere:

\n

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × (12)2

\n

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × 144 = 576π cm2

\n

∴ The correct answer is 576 π cm2.

\n

Additional Information

\n

Volume Conservation

\n

When one solid object is melted and recast into another shape, the Total Volume remains constant, provided there is no wastage.

\n

Sphere Properties

\n

For a sphere of radius R, the Volume is 4/3 × πR3 and the Total Surface Area is 4πR2.

\n

Cylinder Properties

\n

A wire is essentially a thin Cylinder. Its volume is calculated as πr2h, where r is the radius and h is the length.

\n

Unit Conversion

\n

Always ensure all dimensions are in the same unit before calculation. 1 m = 100 cm and 1 cm = 10 mm. Shortcut Trick\n

Given:

\n\n

Radius of the original solid sphere (R) = 20 cm

\n\n

The original sphere is moulded into 8 smaller spheres of equal radius.

\n\n

Formula Used:

\n\n

Volume of a sphere = \\(\\frac{4}{3}πr^3\\)

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Volume of the original sphere = \\(\\frac{4}{3}πR^3\\)

\n\n

Volume of 1 smaller sphere = \\(\\frac{4}{3}πr^3\\)

\n\n

Since the total volume remains the same,

\n\n

Volume of original sphere = Volume of 8 smaller spheres

\n\n

\\(\\frac{4}{3}πR^3\\) = 8 × \\(\\frac{4}{3}πr^3\\)

\n\n

⇒ R3 = 8r3

\n\n

⇒ (20)3 = 8r3

\n\n

⇒ 8000 = 8r3

\n\n

⇒ r3 = 1000

\n\n

\\(⇒r = 10\\)

\n\n

The radius of each ball will be 10 cm.

दिया गया है:

\n\n

मूल ठोस गोले की त्रिज्या (R) = 20 सेमी

\n\n

मूल गोले को बराबर त्रिज्या वाले 8 छोटे गोलों में ढाला गया है।

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

गोले का आयतन = \\(\\frac{4}{3}πr^3\\)

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

मूल गोले का आयतन = \\(\\frac{4}{3}πR^3\\)

\n\n

1 छोटे गोले का आयतन = \\(\\frac{4}{3}πr^3\\)

\n\n

चूँकि कुल आयतन समान रहता है,

\n\n

मूल गोले का आयतन = 8 छोटे गोलों का आयतन

\n\n

\\(\\frac{4}{3}πR^3\\) = 8 × \\(\\frac{4}{3}πr^3\\)

\n\n

⇒ R3 = 8r3

\n\n

⇒ (20)3 = 8r3

\n\n

⇒ 8000 = 8r3

\n\n

⇒ r3 = 1000

\n\n

\\(⇒r = 10\\)

\n\n

प्रत्येक गेंद की त्रिज्या 10 सेमी होगी।

ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

Shortcut Trick\n

Ratio of volumes = (4/3)×π×r3 : π×r2×h

\n

Given the ratio of radius to height is 3 : 4, we directly put r = 3 and h = 4 in the volume formula.

\n

Vsphere : Vcylinder = (4/3)×(3)3 : (3)2×(4)

\n

Vsphere : Vcylinder = (4/3)×27 : 9×4 = 36 : 36 = 1 : 1

\n

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n\n\n\n

\n

\n

\n

Let radius (r) = 3x and height (h) = 4x.

\n\n

Formula Used:

\n

Volume of a sphere = (4/3) × π × r3

\n

Volume of a cylinder = π × r2 × h

\n\n

Calculations:

\n

⇒ Volume of Sphere = (4/3) × π × (3x)3

\n

⇒ Volume of Sphere = (4/3) × π × 27x3 = 36πx3

\n

⇒ Volume of Cylinder = π × (3x)2 × (4x)

\n

⇒ Volume of Cylinder = π × 9x2 × 4x = 36πx3

\n

⇒ Ratio of volumes = 36πx3 : 36πx3

\n

⇒ Ratio = 1 : 1

\n

∴ The correct answer is 1 : 1.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n

Volume of a Sphere

\n

The total space occupied by a sphere is given by V = (4/3)πr3, where r is the radius.

\n

Volume of a Cylinder

\n

The volume of a right circular cylinder is calculated by multiplying its base area by its height: V = πr2h.

\n

Surface Area Properties

\n

The surface area of a sphere is 4πr2. The total surface area of a cylinder is 2πr(r + h), which includes the curved surface and the two circular bases.
